annotations.title: Ask to update a record in Live

description: Asks the founder to update one of Live's own records. Before go-live, update_record changes it at once. This is a change to one customer, so it is your human's approval alone: they approve it in their browser, and no emailed code is asked. Nothing changes until they approve; approving it carries it out — Gemmein does it the moment they press Approve, once, and records what happened on their Logs. The approval page shows Gemmein's own sentence of the real effect, read against Live; a request that no longer matches Live when it is carried out is refused and nothing changes. Returns the approval link for your human and a handle: live_action_status with wait: true answers the moment it is done, or why not — never ask your human to tell you they approved. A second call asks again (a new approval).

note.description: one sentence for your human, shown under Gemmein's own summary

replace.description: true: data is the whole document (a field left out is removed); default: a patch
